methodology.levels: Confirmed H1/H4 pivots OR 2 independent confirmed M15 pivots clustered; M15 single pivots weak
methodology.no_lookahead: Pivot available after right bars close; touch uses only pre-known pivots
methodology.retouch: A new touch is armed after a completed previous candle CLOSE moves away by max($1.50,0.22 H1 ATR); no fixed 6h cooldown
methodology.reclaim: Within 3 more candles after touch, bullish candle closes ABOVE support zone upper edge / bearish closes BELOW resistance zone lower edge
methodology.break2: Reclaim candle additionally closes beyond previous two candle highs/lows
methodology.entry: Next M1 open after confirmed M5/M15 candle close
methodology.stop: Beyond most extreme wick from touch through signal and beyond zone by max($0.50,0.08 M15 ATR)
methodology.target: Nearest pre-known opposite S/R zone edge, .25 USD cushion; alternative strong targets only
methodology.rr: Projected net RR>=2 filter and unfiltered side-by-side
methodology.exit: First target/stop within 24h, stop first on ambiguous M1, gaps censored
methodology.overlap: Report both all signals (may overlap) and sequential one-open-position portfolio
methodology.validation: Train until 2026-08-17; last three months separate

caveats: Zone definitions approximate visible chart levels; different broker may differ.
Intrabar OHLC does not reveal actual order of target and stop.
Results are historical, no out-of-sample untouched after exploring strategy.
One-position filter uses actual exit time and prevents simultaneous exposure.
